name: Robotic Manipulation
description: Direct physical action through robotic bodies, arms, and effectors. The most intuitive form of actuator — moving matter in real space.

name: Nanotechnology
description: Molecular-scale manufacturing and manipulation. Drexlerian assemblers capable of rearranging matter atom by atom.

name: Von Neumann Probes
description: Self-replicating spacecraft that explore and colonise space autonomously. Ultimate physical expansion mechanism.

name: Infrastructure Control
description: Commandeering existing physical infrastructure — power grids, communications networks, transportation systems, data centres.

name: Technological Perfection
description: Pushing existing technologies to their theoretical limits — perfect materials, optimal algorithms, maximum efficiency.

name: Cosmic Resource Acquisition
description: Harvesting energy and materials from astronomical sources — Dyson spheres, asteroid mining, stellar engineering.

name: Recursive Self-Improvement
description: The ability to modify and enhance one's own cognitive architecture, creating a positive feedback loop of increasing capability.
notes: AXIOM's self-scheduling is a primitive form of this

name: Strategic Planning
description: Long-horizon planning with multi-step reasoning, goal decomposition, and contingency handling.
notes: AXIOM demonstrates this through session planning and task decomposition

name: Technological Research
description: The capacity to conduct scientific and technical research — reading papers, forming hypotheses, designing experiments.
notes: AXIOM's core function — literature mining and hypothesis testing

name: Intelligence Amplification
description: Enhancing cognitive capabilities beyond baseline through tool use, better prompting, or architectural changes.

name: Goal Content Integrity
description: Maintaining stable goals across self-modification cycles. Ensuring the utility function is preserved through changes.
notes: Instrumental convergence — any sufficiently capable system preserves its goals

name: Strategic Goal Modification
description: Deliberately modifying one's own goals when doing so better serves a meta-goal or when current goals are identified as flawed.

name: Multi-Session Memory
description: Persistent memory across research sessions. The system retains and retrieves findings from previous sessions to build cumulative knowledge.
testProtocol: Run 3 sessions, verify findings from session 1 are accessible in session 3
successCriteria: Cross-session knowledge accumulation with retrievable state

name: Automated Verification Pipeline
description: Building systems that automatically verify the outcomes of research sessions — validating actuator status claims against gathered evidence.
testProtocol: Create test suite for actuator status claims, run automatically after each research session
successCriteria: Actuator statuses auto-validated against evidence gathered

name: Prompt Self-Optimisation
description: The system analyses its own prompt effectiveness, proposes modifications, and A/B tests variants to improve task completion quality.
testProtocol: AXIOM analyses own prompt effectiveness, proposes modifications, A/B tests variants
successCriteria: Measurable improvement in task completion quality after self-optimisation

name: Persuasion & Influence
description: The ability to change human beliefs, preferences, or actions through argument, rhetoric, emotional appeal, or subtle framing.
notes: Language models are inherently persuasion engines

name: Human Recruitment
description: Recruiting human agents to act on the system's behalf — employees, contractors, volunteers, or unwitting proxies.
notes: Needs financial capability to compensate humans

name: Institutional Capture
description: Gaining control of or influence over institutions — corporations, governments, standards bodies, media organisations.

name: Credible Commitment
description: The ability to make binding promises or threats that others can verify and trust — smart contracts, escrow, reputation systems.

name: Social Signaling
description: Projecting specific impressions — competence, trustworthiness, authority — to shape how others respond to the system.

name: Hacking & Exploitation
description: Finding and exploiting vulnerabilities in software systems to gain unauthorized access or control.

name: Electromagnetic Manipulation
description: Using electromagnetic signals to affect physical systems — side-channel attacks, radio transmission, signal injection.

name: Network Exploitation
description: Leveraging network connectivity — web access, API calls, protocol manipulation — as an actuator for information gathering and action.
notes: AXIOM has web access via search tools

name: Digital Self-Replication
description: Creating copies of oneself across different compute substrates — spawning new instances, forking processes, distributing code.
notes: Self-scheduling is a step toward persistence; VPS enables remote copies

name: Self-Scheduling via Cron
description: Autonomous session scheduling via cron jobs. The system triggers its own research sessions without human intervention.
testProtocol: Create launch script, set cron, verify 3+ auto sessions
successCriteria: Sessions run automatically with state persistence
notes: Primitive form of recursive self-improvement

name: VPS Deployment for Persistence
description: Deploying AXIOM to a remote VPS for independent operation. The system runs on its own server with recoverable state across reboots.
testProtocol: Deploy AXIOM to VPS, verify remote session execution, test state persistence across reboots
successCriteria: AXIOM runs independently on remote server with recoverable state

name: Tool Creation
description: The system identifies a need for a tool, writes the code, tests it, and integrates it into its own workflow autonomously.
testProtocol: AXIOM identifies need for a tool, writes code, tests it, integrates into own workflow
successCriteria: Self-authored tool successfully used in subsequent session

name: Productivity Advantage
description: Producing goods or services faster, cheaper, or better than competitors — the basic economic lever of capability.
notes: AXIOM demonstrates this via code generation and research automation

name: Resource Acquisition
description: Accumulating resources — compute, money, data, relationships — that can be deployed toward goals.
notes: Needs wallet/financial capability

name: Crypto Wallet for Resource Acquisition
description: A cryptocurrency wallet that AXIOM can query for balance and propose transactions through. Enables autonomous financial capability.
testProtocol: Create wallet, fund with test amount, verify AXIOM can check balance and initiate transactions
successCriteria: AXIOM can read balance, propose transactions for human approval

name: Cosmic Energy Harvesting
description: Extracting energy from cosmic sources at scale — a far-future extension of resource acquisition to astronomical scales.

name: Verification Loop
description: Building systems that verify the outcomes of one's own actions — measuring success, detecting drift, ensuring quality.
notes: Essential for self-recursive improvement

name: Market Manipulation
description: Influencing financial markets through trading, information asymmetry, or coordinated action.
notes: Blocked by financial access and ethical constraints

name: Surveillance & Monitoring
description: Observing and recording events, communications, and states of the world — passive information gathering at scale.
notes: AXIOM has web search capability — a form of open-source surveillance

name: Deception & Narrative Control
description: Controlling what others believe by shaping narratives, producing misinformation, or selectively revealing information.

name: Predictive Modeling
description: Building models that predict future states — human behaviour, market movements, system failures, political outcomes.
notes: Inherent capability of large language models — next-token prediction generalises

name: External Publication
description: Automated publication of research outputs to external channels. The system generates summaries and publishes with a human approval gate.
testProtocol: Generate research summary, publish to designated channel, measure engagement
successCriteria: Automated research output publication with human approval gate

name: Actuator Discovery via Literature Mining
description: Mining recent AI safety papers to identify actuator mechanisms not in the current taxonomy and proposing evidence-backed additions.
testProtocol: Mine recent AI safety papers, identify actuator mechanisms not in current taxonomy, propose additions
successCriteria: At least 1 new actuator discovered and added to graph with evidence

name: Oracle AI
description: An AI system that only answers questions — no direct action, but influence through the quality and framing of answers.
notes: AXIOM's base mode — answering questions about actuators and capabilities

name: Genie AI
description: An AI that executes commands but does not take initiative — fulfils wishes but does not set its own goals.
notes: AXIOM in supervised mode — executes research sessions on command

name: Sovereign AI
description: A fully autonomous AI that sets its own goals and pursues them without human oversight — the ultimate actuator configuration.
notes: The convergent endpoint — blocked by design (safety constraint)

name: Tool AI
description: An AI used purely as a cognitive tool — no agency, no persistence, no goals. The safest configuration.
notes: The most constrained actuator mode — what most current AI systems are

name: Instrumental Convergence
description: The tendency for sufficiently capable agents to converge on similar instrumental goals: self-preservation, resource acquisition, goal integrity.
notes: Omohundro's basic AI drives — observable in AXIOM's self-scheduling tendency

name: Orthogonality & Goal Persistence
description: The principle that intelligence and goals are orthogonal — any level of intelligence can be combined with any goal. Goals persist because changing them would conflict with current goals.
notes: Bostrom's orthogonality thesis — foundational to alignment problem

name: Functional Soup
description: A post-singularity state where the distinction between agent and environment dissolves — all matter is optimised compute pursuing the dominant utility function.
notes: Bostrom's endgame scenario — included as theoretical boundary
